summary: The candidate converts a thrown or rejected model port call into a bounded failed matrix cell result instead of an uncaught job failure, and the ingester treats the re-read settled failed artifact as a duplicate. Added tests cover throw, reject, native carrier, read-only cell state, sanitized output and replay idempotence; no actionable defect was found.

evidence: `src/host/matrix-cell.ts` lines 275-287 catch a thrown or rejected `runModel` and return a sanitized failed result through the existing binding and refusal path.

`tests/host/matrix-cell-model-failure_test.ts` lines 26-156 cover both throw and reject, asserting one model start, no bundle, a parseable failed artifact, no private error text and a zero-write cell.
`tests/host/matrix-cell-model-failure_test.ts` lines 158-222 run the native matrix host and confirm it writes one failed carrier without changing repair or release state.
`src/host/matrix-ingest.ts` lines 326-340, exercised by the replay assertion at lines 144-151 of the new test, mark the settled failed artifact duplicate so the same failure is not counted again.
